concern: Overwhelming, intrusive thoughts about living forever after death that lead to panic and anxiety, plus fear of being crazy or abnormal.
first_advice: I suggest that you consider counseling to help you with your anxiety
acknowledged_before_advice: The opening normalizes the experience: 'Many people generate intense anxiety with obsessive thinking... while the nature of your obsession... appear very powerful and unique to you, the pattern of obsessing about one thing/area is common.' This recognizes how powerful the thoughts feel and speaks to the fear of not being normal.
